description:
List a wallet's alerts -- what is currently armed. Free read.

Covers both price/position alerts (set_alert) and health-factor liquidation
alerts (set_liquidation_alert) -- one table, told apart by alert_type.
Default shows only ARMED alerts (active, not yet triggered) -- exactly the
set the Celery evaluators will act on. include_triggered=True adds already-
tripped and deactivated alerts (recent history). limit caps at 200.

Workflow: MONITOR step -- read before arming another alert so you do not
duplicate a level that is already watched. Pairs with set_alert. See
get_trading_workflow.
name: list_alerts
